module-5-customer-follow-up-capstone.label: Module 5 Customer Follow-Up Capstone
module-5-customer-follow-up-capstone.summary: Build a production-ready follow-up report by carrying one SQL query through status, contactability, location/date, pattern, sorting, and row-limit requirements.

cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.title: Build the eligible-status slice
cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.prompt: Lifecycle operations wants a follow-up candidate list. Return `full_name`, `city`, and `status` from `customers`, in that order. Keep customers whose status is either `active` or `draft`.
cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.hint: The starter keeps only one status. Replace that single-value filter with the list operator that accepts either approved status.

help.concept: IN is a concise exact-value filter when any value from a short approved list may match.
help.hint_1: Keep the selected columns and table unchanged.
help.hint_2: Change only the status condition so both approved statuses qualify.

cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.starterCode:
-- The starter keeps only active customers.
-- Expand the filter so active and draft customers are both eligible.
SELECT
  full_name,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status = 'active';
cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft');

cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.title: Keep real contactable customers
cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.prompt: The outreach system can only use real records with an email address. Carry the approved status slice forward, add `email` to the result, require a present email value, and exclude test rows.
cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.hint: Keep the status rule from the previous milestone, then add one presence check and one test-record condition.

help.concept: Cumulative SQL work preserves approved logic and adds only the new business rules.
help.hint_1: Do not replace the IN filter from milestone 1.
help.hint_2: Add email to SELECT, then require a present email and is_test = 0.

cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.starterCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft');
cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0;

cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.title: Add location and signup-date focus
cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.prompt: Regional operations is running this follow-up only for Chicago or Seattle customers who signed up from `2026-01-10` through `2026-02-05`, inclusive. Carry the approved query forward, add `signup_date`, and apply both the city list and date-window requirements.
cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.hint: Use one exact-value list for the two cities and one inclusive range for signup_date.

help.concept: IN handles the approved city set; BETWEEN handles an inclusive lower-and-upper date boundary.
help.hint_1: Preserve the status, email-presence, and non-test requirements.
help.hint_2: Add signup_date to SELECT, then add the city and date filters with AND.

cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.starterCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0;
cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status,
  signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0
  AND city IN ('Chicago', 'Seattle')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05';

cp-4-finish-capstone-report.title: Deliver the ranked final handoff
cp-4-finish-capstone-report.prompt: For the final handoff, keep only names containing the letter `a`. Sort the approved records by `signup_date` from earliest to latest and return only the first five rows. Do not remove any requirement from the previous milestone.
cp-4-finish-capstone-report.hint: Add a contains-pattern filter, then place ORDER BY after WHERE and LIMIT after ORDER BY.

help.concept: The final report combines filtering with deterministic ordering before LIMIT chooses the first rows.
help.hint_1: Keep every filter already approved in milestone 3.
help.hint_2: Add the name LIKE condition, ORDER BY signup_date ASC, then LIMIT 5.

cp-4-finish-capstone-report.starterCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status,
  signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0
  AND city IN ('Chicago', 'Seattle')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05';
cp-4-finish-capstone-report.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status,
  signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0
  AND city IN ('Chicago', 'Seattle')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05'
  AND full_name LIKE '%a%'
ORDER BY signup_date ASC
LIMIT 5;
